events.body:
## Context

`public/index.html` has a "View on GitHub" button that links to git.owaspblt.org; `#projects-grid` is `role="list" aria-live` and contains a `role="alert"` element; footer links are given `role="listitem"`, which hides them as links; the search box has `outline: none`.

## What to do

1. Change the button text to "Source code".
2. Move `#no-results` outside the list with `role="status"`; drop `aria-live` from the grid.
3. Use a real `<ul><li><a>` in the footer; add a `:focus-visible` outline.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] axe reports no ARIA errors
- [ ] Focus ring visible on search and filters

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-nexus/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```
